items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I saw Barney is on it I think -- Barney McCarthy. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, I don't know. I haven't heard anything though.

ctx.x: No. Not really. There was a singing teacher used to come up there from down at the white school. Her name was Miss McCarthy. And she'd come up and -- you know -- teach us singing -- like that -- do, re, me, fa, sol, la, te, do. E, g, b, d, f.
I don't pay any mind to e, g, b, d, f though -- you know. It's -- you know -- the thing like that. Do, re, me, fa, sol, la, te, do is easy for me, so that's the way I learned -- you know.
